claims.family_support: AAP sibling bonds: one-to-one time, cooperation, clear no-hitting rules and calm intervention for physical/emotional wellbeing concerns. Comparison advice retained as app parenting guidance, not a quoted diagnosis.
claims.referral: AACAP help and NHS anxiety support assessment for school/function decline, severe fears and frequent physical complaints. Repeated injurious aggression/bullying is a safety concern, not normal rivalry to ignore.
claims.immediate_safety: AAP intervention plus AACAP outburst active safety concerns: protect children now, urgent help for serious injury or imminent harm.
claims.timing: No six-month aggression waiting rule, no fixed delay before safeguarding.
